method: GEN conditional-CFG instruction sums, not cycles. 16 paired weights means eight gate plus eight up weights; common activation traffic counted once. Counts are SIMD instructions normalized per active lane weight, not divided again by SIMD32. Odd/tail/nonfinite paths excluded from hot-path figures and retained in full compressed dumps.
